'''Chall Bekan''' was a [[Force-attunement|Force-attuned]] [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As a leader, he had connections to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] government on<ref name="CCG" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Adriana">{{CSWECite|I|12|Adriana}}</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CCG" /> Bekan maintained a network of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Spy/Legends|agents]], which he used to keep surveillance on both<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|67|Bekan, Chall}}</ref> the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|130|Jabba the Hutt (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" />

Bekan was a [[Methane/Legends|methane]] breather who [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] an [[Environment suit/Legends|environment suit]] and a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]],<ref name="CCG" /> both of which were worn by his [[Species/Legends|species]] in low-methane environments.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' establishes that a [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]] [[Clothing/Legends|wears]] both an [[Environment suit/Legends|environment suit]] and a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] in [[Methane/Legends|methane]]-poor environments.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Chall Bekan was created for [[1998]]'s ''[[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]]'' of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" /> In [[2024]], the user [[User:Karlemayn|Karlemayne]] on the fan site [[Wookieepedia]] mentioned being [[Chuck Kallenbach]], who worked as Decipher's game designer at the time of the ''Official Tournament Sealed Deck'' being released. Karlemayne said Bekan was [[Tuckerization|named as]] an anagram of Kallenbach's surname,<ref name="Wook edit">{{WookCite|url=User_talk:Hanzo_Hasashi?diff=prev&oldid=13297670|text=April 8, 2024 revision of the "User talk:Hanzo Hasashi" page}}</ref> and Kallenbach later confirmed on his Twitter account that he was indeed Karlemayne, thus confirming Chall Bekan was named after him.<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|chuckkallenbach|status/1777382745422905612|[[Chuck Kallenbach]]|quote=Yes, that is correct. Karlemayn is me [with [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/User_talk:Hanzo_Hasashi#Chall_Bekan this message] about Chall Bekan's name].|archivefile=File:Kallenbach_tweet.png}}</ref>
